The '''Andobi Mountains''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. The ancient resting place of a [[Tho Yor]], the ship took a large group of [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu monks]] from the world when it departed for [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the millennia before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] formation.

==History==
[[File:Ando_Prime_Outlander_Club.png|thumb|left|180px|A hologram of a podrace held at the base of the Andobi Mountains]]
A snow-covered mountain ridge, the Andobi Mountains became the resting place of a [[Tho Yor]] sometime before [[37,453 BBY]]. When the native [[Talid/Legends|Talid]] people discovered the ancient and alien structure, the [[Order of Dai Bendu]] monks established the site as a holy space and practiced [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] around the base of the structure. For over a millennium the monks contemplated the mysteries of the foreign construct until it one day began to sing to the monks through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Hearing the Tho Yor's song, the Dai Bendu boarded the Tho Yor, and the ancient edifice lifted out of its cradle in the mountain's slope and left Ando Prime forever.<ref name="DotJ1" />

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] were held near the Andobi Mountains and were broadcast for entertainment. One such race played on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreen]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]].<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref>
